<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

You are the cross-model reviewer for plan 131-baseline-red-tests. Review the composed implementation in this PM worktree read-only. Judge plan fidelity, fail-closed npm behavior, worktree teardown stability, evidence quality, and scope; return only material findings.

<a id="instructions"></a>

## Instructions

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| i1 | Orient: read the plan (rendered .dd.md), the impl-guide (the intended decomposition + interfaces), and then the full diff of the branch against its base. DOGFOOD FLOWSPACE: use `flowspace3 search` to locate consumers/related code by meaning while reviewing; report misses as friction. |
| i2 | Review with the /builder review discipline: verify claims against fresh evidence — run targeted tests yourself, read exit status, never trust a green claim you did not see. |
| i2b | Three required lists: (1) WHERE THE AUTHOR IS LEAST CONFIDENT: the hand-written npm semantic-version comparison at prerelease/version boundaries; whether an HTTP npmjs lock URL faithfully isolates replace-registry-host semantics; whether five 100ms rmSync retries are sufficient under loaded macOS teardown. (2) DISBELIEVE THE AUTHOR RECEIPTS: independently inspect the diff and re-run the targeted npm/worktree tests; treat execution.log.md and live-proof.md as claims to verify, not proof to trust. (3) KNOWN-OPEN: none in plan scope; full harness checks passed all eight sensors with zero skips. Pre-existing named suite skips and the Biome schema-version info line are not plan findings. |
| i3 | Priority order: (1) plan promises that are not actually true, (2) composition-seam defects between units, (3) interface drift from the impl-guide, (4) correctness/safety in the changed code, (5) test gaps on the contract. Style noise is unwanted. |
| i4 | Findings: at most the material ones, each with severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM), exact location, the claim, the proof, and the smallest fix. `no_material_findings` is a valid verdict. |
| i5 | Deliver as a ddoc review record in the plan folder (assets/reviews/), build it, and send the PM the path + a one-line verdict. |
